consumption_module_declaration.compiles_to: the earnings22 direct layer = configs/baseline/e22-native-window-direct-base-v1.json policy blocks
consumption_module_declaration.why_not_native_episode: A direct program carries no native_episode block (the native-episode loader refuses one on any program that is not the native-role episode), so the declaration lives here and is proven by the byte proof rather than verified by the loader.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id (a new generation attempt id); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program makes exactly one contact per native window: 4 windows x 1. No fit identity (the direct baseline declares none, as the flown E35 direct arms). Ceilings, not targets; run-cumulative across attempts.

purpose: Four-row form smoke of the evidence-consumption module's ALL-OFF arm on earnings22: every component off, which compiles to the carrier's DIRECT layer. Earnings-22 has no locked system and no direct parent cell: the shared direct layer e22-native-window-direct-base-v1 (the phase-direct-only-v1 program and its one phase_material.direct entry, the generic transcription instruction bytes shared with E21) is the whole comparator, so the module's all-off arm is that base fragment plus the E21-shaped native-window geometry and pins on the Earnings-22 dev split. No knowledge supply, no ConEC layer, no entity scorer, no analytical tool. It is the carrier admission gate of design section 2b.3: the module-bare arm on the carrier's own roster before any component is turned on there. Own null: Earnings-22 has NO measured own null on this form (no cell has ever flown on the native-window dev form); the module null is unmeasured until an in-chain A/A of this arm seals (design 2b.3). The all-off arm is therefore a form proof only, and no benefit may be claimed on this carrier until that A/A exists. A FORM proof: it claims no benefit, admits nothing and compares no mechanism; no component-on cell exists for this carrier. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28 and 86).

stage3_algorithm.note: This cell carries NO training-free RL operator and says so explicitly: it is the evidence-consumption module with every component off on a carrier with no locked system -- the carrier's direct baseline expressed as a module block, the carrier admission gate of the consumption-module design (section 2b.3). No rollout, no per-sample scoring, no credit assignment, no update operator, no evolving store and no mechanism.
